reply: clean (the t-modulated sinusoid amplitudes and the P² term are small but nonzero), so I could not pin down the exact closed form. My last evaluated candidate, a + b·t + c·P·lnP + d/P + f·t/P + (e·sin + g·cos)/P, reached NMSE 1.1e-5, so dropping the t-modulated sinusoid terms costs too much accuracy.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,w = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7]
    s=np.sin(w*t); cc=np.cos(w*t)
    return a + b*t + c*P*np.log(P) + d/P + f*t/P + (e*s + g*cc)/P
